name: Battery Plus
author: enigmazflo
description: Lightweight event-driven battery widget: icon, wattage, percentage, charging animation, drain prediction, and power-profile switching.

barWidget.description: Battery icon, live wattage and percentage, time-to-empty tooltip, click to switch power profile.

schema.label: Sysfs fallback poll interval (ms)
schema.description: Only used when UPower bindings are unavailable. 10000-30000 recommended.

schema.label: Drain history sample interval (ms)
schema.description: How often to record a discharge sample for prediction.

schema.label: Graph hover details
schema.description: Hovering the history graph shows time, level, and status at the nearest sample.

schema.label: Battery icon style
schema.description: Canvas-drawn icon. Battery fills to the real percentage; Battery + % leaves the body empty with the number inside.

schema.label: Wattage animation
schema.description: Glow: halo breathes while charging, brighter under load. Counting: odometer rollers per digit. Shimmer: digits glow in the direction of change. Heat: color follows load. Off: plain text.
